title: Sortedness precondition
task: Return whether list contains target using binary search; caller promises sorted input.
code:
def contains(values, target):
    left, right = 0, len(values)-1
    while left <= right:
        mid=(left+right)//2
        if values[mid] == target: return True
        if values[mid] < target: left=mid+1
        else: right=mid-1
    return False
